summary: WeRide Inc. filed a Form 6-K attaching a Next Day Disclosure Return under Hong Kong Listing Rules, reporting a routine share repurchase. On May 28, 2026, the company repurchased 1,518,900 ordinary shares on the Stock Exchange of Hong Kong at HKD 19.687 per share, holding them as treasury shares. No board recommendation or advisor is named. The filing is a standard post-trade disclosure, not a special situation. There are no deal terms, premium, or strategic catalysts; the event is an ordinary capital management activity.
